thread:
oliver: Proposal  run a small "privacy-first" private deployment beta (on-prem/VPC) with 5 design partners. Focus: validate onboarding, KMS/HSM keyflows, audit logging, and a clean DP addendum for regulated customers. 8-week runway.

priya: Yes. Recruiting criteria: SOC2 or equivalent, infra team willing to run our agent image, security contact, and data residency requirement. Prefer partners with existing HSM or KMS.

marco: Technical scope: deliverable = turnkey private package + onboarding doc + audit checklist. Tests: key rotation, network isolation test, and end-to-end logging with obfuscated PII. Need to define what level of telemetry we accept (none vs minimal).

ella: Success criteria idea: (A) partner completes onboarding checklist end-to-end within 3 weeks, (B) KMS/HSM integration validated, (C) partner signs off on logs/audit format, AND (D) at least one feature routed in prod for 4+ weeks post-pilot.

recruiter-kim: Outreach template draft:

"Hi <name>,
We6re running a short privacy-first private-beta for on-prem / VPC deployments with strict telemetry controls. 8 weeks, we provide deployment support and an audit checklist. Interested? If yes, reply with your compliance contact and whether you use an HSM/KMS.
Thanks, Kim"

legal-bot: DP addendum flags: telemetry opt-in checkbox, minimal retention (30 days max), right to pause/terminate, indemnity carve-outs, and clear data-flow diagrams required. Also add an expedited rollback clause for security incidents.

ops-bot: capacity note: on-prem engagements need 2x SE support days/week during onboarding. Estimate 40h total per partner. Timeboxed windows to avoid overcommitment.

marco: We need a checklist snippet in repo (example):

```
- Confirm network peering & firewall rules
- Verify KMS/HSM key wrap + rotation
- Validate audit log shipping (no raw PII)
- Run failover + rollback drill
```

priya: For telemetry choose one of three modes: NONE (no telemetry), MINIMAL (health + anonymized metrics), FULL (debug logs with partner consent). Default to MINIMAL unless partner requests NONE. Document exact fields captured.

ella: CS metrics: partner satisfaction >= 8/10, onboarding time <= 3w, and adoption signal (feature live) for 4 weeks. Also get a short post-pilot checklist and quick case study permission.

recruiter-kim: Prioritization rubric: Compliance fit (0-5), On-prem-readiness (0-4), Business impact (0-3). Threshold 8/12. Target list = customers with open private-deployment requests last 6 months.

marco: Next steps: Kim to send invites by Tue, Legal to draft DP addendum by Wed, Ops to confirm SE availability by Thu, Priya to prepare onboarding checklist PR by Fri.

oliver: Agree. Add an optional extra: offer SOC2 alignment workshop for participants as an incentive (2-hour session). Any objections?

priya: :thumbsup: no objections.

marco: I'll open the checklist PR today.
